title: Jesus... Why Does My Mind Get Loud The Moment I Lie Down?

bible.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why does my mind get loud the moment I lie down? It's 3 AM again. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I replay every stupid thing I said today. Then I start worrying about tomorrow.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You held everything together all day. At night there's nothing left to distract you, so it all comes out at once.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I've tried everything. Music, no phone, counting. Nothing works.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You've been trying to win a fight with your own thoughts. You don't have to win tonight. You can hand them to Me.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: And what if the worries are real? What if tomorrow really goes wrong?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then I'll be there tomorrow too. You don't have to stay awake to keep watch. That's My job, not yours.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Put it down. Close your eyes. I've got the night.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What usually keeps you awake at night? 🙏
